'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Chris Gogolen LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''If it ain't broke'''. L31 Inconsequential Barriers (V) over scratch. L59 Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
